answer.sentence: Revenue for 16–22 Oct 2026: 1.84M TL. GA4 revenue: −10.3% against the source, so the check does not add up. The gap is on mobile (−15.9%) and starts on 9 Oct.

query.sql:
-- metric revenue v2
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', date) AS DATE) AS week,
  SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-16' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week
